# Vendored zed-xim

This source is from `zed-industries/xim-rs` commit `16f35a2c881b815a2b6cdfd6687988e84f8447d8`, previously pinned as a Git dependency. The root manifest updates `x11rb` from 0.13 to 0.14. `ascii-designation.patch` fixes the compound-text decoder treating the `ESC ( B` ASCII designation as literal text; the pinned upstream test for a Japanese string ending in that designation fails without it. This is a local fork, not a published replacement for zed-xim; re-evaluate and remove it when upstream supports a compatible version. The upstream MIT license is retained.

`upstream.json` records the original bytes and SHA-256 of every retained upstream file and the reviewed patch. `tests/quality/test_xim_vendor.py` verifies the exact inventory, reverses the patch in a disposable directory, and restores the manifest requirement in memory before comparing upstream hashes. The designation is specified by [X Consortium Compound Text](https://xorg.freedesktop.org/archive/current/doc/xorg-docs/ctext/ctext.html).
